column4: I support this future if AI helps consumers shop better and reduce waste. But if people are exposed to 4,000 AI-influenced attempts per day and their choices are being changed without their knowledge, that is a concern. Despite mental defense classes, if AI can change opinions, it will impact independent thinking. I would like a future where AI is helpful, but does not have hidden influence.
